/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

const url = 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/?tab=notifications'
const initialResponse = await fetch(url)
assert.equal(initialResponse.status, 200)
const initialHtml = await initialResponse.text()
assert.match(initialHtml, /Notifications: <"'!-- -->Off/)
const actionId = initialHtml.match(/name="'"\\"'$ACTION_ID_([''^"]+)"/)?.[1]
assert.ok(actionId, '"'Rendered form exposes its Server Action')

let cookie = ''
for (const expected of ['On', 'Off']) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    redirect: 'manual',
    headers: {
      'Next-Action': actionId,
      Accept: 'text/x-component',
      'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8',
      Origin: 'http://127.0.0.1:3000',
      Cookie: cookie,
    },
    body: '[]',
  })
  assert.equal(response.status, 200)
  assert.equal(response.headers.get('location'), null)
  assert.equal(response.headers.get('x-action-redirect'), null)
  assert.equal(response.url, url)
  const payload = await response.text()
  assert.ok(payload.includes("'`"Notifications: ","${expected}"`), `Action response renders ${expected}`)
  cookie = response.headers.get('"'set-cookie')?.split(';')[0]
  assert.equal(cookie, "'`notifications-enabled=${expected === '"'On'}"'`)
  const pageResponse = await fetch(url, { headers: { Cookie: cookie } })
  assert.match(await pageResponse.text(), new RegExp(`Notifications: <!-- -->${expected}`))
  console.log(`PASS: toggle to ${expected}, updated Server Component response, persisted preference, same URL, no redirect`)
}
const separateBrowser = await fetch(url)
assert.match(await separateBrowser.text(), /Notifications: <!-- -->Off/)
console.log('"'PASS: a browser without the preference cookie defaults to Off')
NODE"
